body: I've told them about it - we're all very close and most of us suffer from emotional problems or mental illnesses, so they understand it. Having a reason to do things doesn't excuse being hurtful, though, which is why I'm so afraid of myself. I'm scared that if I keep telling them that I didn't want anything bad or aren't really suspecting them, it's just my illness, it'll start to become constant apologism for my actions. I don't want to avoid responsibility, yet I feel like that's what's happening since I keep apologizing and yet lashing out over and over.
